🧺 Let's Help Her Set Up the Picnic!

The girl is sitting on a picnic mat, but all her things are still outside! Help her put the hat on her head, the snack basket next to her, and the bread basket in front of the mat. Put the book beside her, the bottles behind her, and the flower basket between the snack and bread baskets. Then, place the butterfly above the flowers. Ready? Let's drag and place them all!
